# ignitify_whoami (Data Source)

The tenant, the calling API key and the quota snapshot. Works with any key.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ignitify_whoami" "me" {}

# Stop early when the configuration needs an owner key.
check "owner_key" {
  assert {
    condition     = data.ignitify_whoami.me.is_owner_key
    error_message = "This configuration manages access and needs an owner key."
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `groups` (Set of String) The groups of the key's user.
- `is_owner_key` (Boolean) Whether the calling key is an owner key.
- `key_id` (String) The resource id of the calling key.
- `limits` (Attributes) The summary limits. A null limit is unlimited. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--limits))
- `permissions` (Set of String) The permissions the key holds.
- `status` (String) The tenant status.
- `tenant_id` (String) The tenant id.
- `tenant_name` (String) The tenant name.
- `tier_name` (String) The tenant's tier.
- `tier_version` (Number) The tier version.
- `usage` (Attributes) What the tenant holds now. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--usage))
- `user` (String) The user that holds the calling key; null for an owner key.
